violation_type.title: Written Operational Policies - Procedures for Parents Participation (26 TAC §744.501(19))
violation_type.short_title: Written Operational Policies - Procedures for Parents Participation
violation_type.typical_finding: There were no clear policies on sunscreen and insect repellent procedures. Additionally, the information on how to review the latest licensing inspection form needs to be expanded. There were also no policies regarding employee vaccinations.
